text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Live concert this afternoon! Everyone, 
come watch~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An independent live performance planned 
and executed by the students themselves. 
It is a wonderful sight, unique to the 
freedom of Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you regret coming! Please come 
watch meee!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah. This? Well, you see—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be participating in a unit!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who invited her☆ Watching her 
run just gave me a huge spark!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after no one's back, simply 
running with all her might in pursuit of 
glory alone!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Seeing them like that made me overlap them 
with everyone in our unit!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Well, nothing ventured, nothing gained! So 
you'd better come see today's performance, 
no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Told that, I had no choice but to go 
watch. Besides, I was genuinely curious to 
see what the unit concert featuring her 
would be like.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyooone!! Thanks for coming today♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, there were a lot of members 
who couldn't make it~... But instead!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Today, we have a special guest~♪ Who do 
you think it is~? Wanna know~?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Okay, as a special treat~♪ Our 
guest is... right here!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's Katsuragi Ace-senpai☆

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Are you guys hyped up or what?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (!! ...Yaaaaay!!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Woooow! You're totally fired up! It's rare 
to see this kind of vibe, but it really 
gets me hyped!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right on☆ Then let's keep this momentum 
going and blaze through the second song 
tooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeah! This is the ab-so-lute beeest!! 
Sprinting full-throttle together on pure 
momentum! That feeling of unity is 
awesome, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! That's the magic of a live 
performance♪ Is everyone having the 
absolute best tiiiime?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! What a roar! I can't let them outdo 
me!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Next time, I'll run across the 
entire stage even more.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's so like Suzuka-chan☆ But 
let's get them hyped with our singing and 
dancing too♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"All right! Let's go, then!! We're gonna 
pump things up even moooore!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! That was such a 
wonderful concert, wasn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That excitement! That unity with the 
fans! And this pleasant exhaustion... It's 
the best!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ace-senpai! Today's live performance 
convinced me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Won't you join my unit?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"When I did the live performance with 
Senpai, I felt like the unit's sense of 
unity grew even stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, guys! Performing that live with 
you all was the absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: In that case—!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Still, sorry about that.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I really do want to shine at center stage. 
A center stage that I seized with my own 
two hands!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
When all's said and done, I feel like my 
fans want to see that kind of thing too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I see... Ah, that's unfair of you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When you put it so coolly like that, how 
could I ever try to stop you?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Hit me up again if another chance 
comes up! I'll drop by every now and then!

I talked a big game. So I've gotta train 
harder and get the crowd seriously fired

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thanks to that, I want to stand on 
the Winning Live stage more than ever now.
